description: Skill retrieval over the framework's and the tools component's skills, run with no model (moqui test tools --skills, and the core test the_committed_retrieval_set_reaches_its_recall). Each case: the query (a message as a user writes it), an optional page, the skills one of which must be in the top three (expect), and skills that must not match strongly (negatives). A case with no expect must match nothing strongly.
